- scripts/review_annotate_sticky.sh:121-134 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: `parse_line_spec` uses `re.search(r'([0-9]+)(?:\s*-\s*([0-9]+))?', value)`, so it matches the first number anywhere in the string and misparses path-qualified references with digits.
  WHY: A `Code:` line like `scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:123` is read as line `2` instead of `123`, so sticky-repeat detection compares the wrong line range and can silently miss or mis-associate findings.
- scripts/review_annotate_sticky.sh:271-276 | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `finalize_chunk`'s `path_match` regex `re.search(r'([A-Za-z0-9_./-]+):([0-9]+)', line_ref)` extracts the first colon-digit pair instead of the trailing file-path/line pair.
  WHY: For references like `src/v2/module.py:123`, it can bind the wrong file path and line number, causing sticky finding matches to be attributed to the wrong location.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:134-142 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: `parse_line_spec` in `review_reject_verify.sh` has the same first-number regex bug and can misparse path-qualified line references containing digits.
  WHY: Prior-artifact comparisons then operate on the wrong line numbers for paths like `orchestrate_state_v2.py`, which can accept or reject matches incorrectly.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:151 | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `sticky_line_bucket` has no upper bound on `STICKY_LINE_BUCKET`.
  WHY: A misconfigured very large value can make the verifier accept almost any shifted-line prior-round rejection as support, effectively disabling the line-range check.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:410-424 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The bucket-aware prior-round line comparison is applied without a `STICKY_FINDINGS_ENABLED` gate.
  WHY: When the feature flag is false, shifted-line rejections within `STICKY_LINE_BUCKET` can still be treated as support instead of being reverted to `must-fix`, changing the verifier's default semantics.
- scripts/review_reject_verify.sh:413-422 | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
